description: An app's daily metric history per country: rating, ratings count, reviews count, installs (Play), star histogram and price, one row per day a value changed (default the last 90 days), with the change over the period. Use it to chart growth or spot rating drops after a release. Cost: 1 + 1 per country refreshed (max 10) credits.

app.description: Any app identifier: App Store id (`284882215`, `id284882215`), Play package (`com.spotify.music`), Apple bundle id (`com.spotify.client`), store URL (URL-encoded), `apple:<id>` / `play:<id>`, or a name (`spotify`). Example: com.spotify.music

country.description: ISO country code(s): `us` (default), a comma list (paid plans), or `all` (Studio). Example: us,de

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

store.description: Disambiguates `{app}` (a bundle id vs a Play package, or a name).

name: get_app_history
title: Get App History
